Ruth (CS): Starting handoff thread for CruxLabs dedicated bring-up. Need: quota mapping, burst billing visibility, autoscale policy, and two load-test windows. cc @Omar @Felix @Nora
Nora (AE): Contract shows 90 sustained tokens/s, 280 burst for 8m. Crux wants separate bill line for bursts. Finance will only sign with 30d visible usage.
Omar (Eng): For autoscale I propose policy 'crux-bounded-v1': min=2, target latency p95<200ms, scale on token-queue > 18ms for 60s, max_replicas = base * 3. Thoughts?
Felix (SRE): Prefer token-rate primary, fallback to CPU. Set cooldown 120s and min-ready 1 to reduce cold starts. Also recommend priming step before stress probe.
Ruth (CS): Load tests: (1) Prime 90m at 55% sustained; (2) Spike suite: three 6m spikes to 280 across 40m; (3) Regression burst: 1h mixed seq lengths. Prefer Mon 01:00-04:00 PT.
Omar (Eng): I'll drop a k6 scenario and a tiny priming snippet in docs. k6 sample: ```k6 run --vus 120 --duration 90m --rps 90 ./load/crux_prime.js```
ci-bot: autoscale policy 'crux-bounded-v1' queued for staging at 2024-06-12T22:11:00Z
Felix (SRE): Staging canary shows p95=185ms, error=0.05%, cache-hit=66% with prefills. Good baseline.
Ruth (CS): Success criteria to record: p95 < 240ms, error rate < 0.7%, < 3 cold-starts per spike. If breached during first 30d flag renewal risk and offer optimization workshop.
Nora (AE): I'll get finance to sign burst-billing consent and post link here.
Omar (Eng): Action items: I - push k6 + priming doc; Felix - book test window + runbook + canary; Nora - finance consent; Ruth - invite + feedback form + collect token dist.
Ruth (CS): Thanks all. Will send invites once test window is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
